title: QwT-v2: Practical, Effective and Efficient Post-Training Quantization
selection_reason: QwT-v2 improves post-training quantization with lightweight compensating structures while removing the extra latency and incompatibility of the original QwT; a practical quantization contribution directly reducing model inference resource use, hence accept.
